newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares end sharply easier, just off day lows.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares end sharply easier, just off day lows.

text.p: Italian stocks ended an easier session sharply lower on Wednesday just off day's lows on Wall Street's losses and weakness in the debt market. Traded volume was seen at only a modest 500 billion lire.
"It was a day of just following other foreign markets in a market lacking impetus and a direction of its own," one trader said.
The All-share Mibtel index closed 1.15 percent down at 10,226 against a low of 10,211 and the Mib30 blue chip index ended 1.26 percent off at 15,222 after a day's low of 15,193.
De Benedetti group holdings which were again firm early in the session ended lower in line with the market, with industrial holding Cir down 4.27 percent at 957.1 lire.
Fiat, however, ended firmer against the trend, up a modest 0.23 percent at 4,313 lire scambi.
Energy group ENI was 1.09 percent lower at 7,700 lire. Dealers said it was paying the price of a strong rally which took the share price above 8,000 lire a couple of weeks ago.
TV and advertising group Mediaset ended 0.52 percent off at 7,067 despite government accord to extend brodcasting licences to end-May from end-January.
Telecoms were all down with Stet holding off 1.72 percent at 6,188 lire.
Financial holding Gemina was off 2.18 percent at 722.1. "On a chart basis there is a possibility of a correction to 700-720 but the stock is still in a bullish range," one dealer said.
Banks were all easier with Banca di Roma down 1.88 percent to 1,302 lire.
